name: Amazon Bedrock
tagline: AWS's managed service for building generative AI applications and agents with models from several providers.
about: Amazon Bedrock gives access to models from Amazon and other providers through one API inside your AWS account, with tools for agents, knowledge bases and safety controls.
pros: One API for models from several providers.
Runs inside your AWS account with its security controls.
Tools for agents, knowledge bases and guardrails.
cons: Pricing varies by model and is hard to estimate.
